messages:
maria_cs: FYI — onboarding for three enterprise customers hit a VPC auth regression overnight. customers: Acme Corp (Reserved), Harlow Health ( Dedicated ), BlueBay Media (trial enterprise). Need a coordinated customer update and remediation plan by EOD. incident-bot: INC-5247 created (vpc-auth-failed) — severity: high.
jonathan_se: Thanks. Do we have root cause signal yet? is this config/infra or library change?
kai_onboarding: Short version: token exchange started failing for new onboarding flows after a release to the private control plane at 02:10 UTC. Existing sessions OK. Likely deployment config mismatch w/our new KMS state.
nana_csm: Quick ask for comms: can we give each account an ETA window and an offer (credit + enablement session)? renewal risk on Acme is medium-high — upcoming contract review.
vinay_support: I can do a first-touch note for each account with specifics and mitigations. Suggest: interim workaround (manual token reset) + scheduled one-on-one enablement.
ops_lead: I'm pairing with infra. Immediate mitigation: roll back the control-plane change for new tokens and add a temporary allowlist for legacy token exchange. ETA 45–60m for rollback.
maria_cs: Draft customer note (please iterate):
```
Hi [Customer],
We’re investigating an issue impacting new onboardings to private/VPC deployments. Existing traffic is not affected.
What we’re doing: rolling back a recent control-plane change, applying a temporary token-exchange allowlist, and offering a manual token reset for affected keys.
ETA: initial mitigation within 60 minutes, full validation within 4 hours.
What we’ll do for you: direct enablement session, one-time account credit, and an RCA when complete.
Apologies for the interruption — we’ll keep you updated.
Best,
Redwood Customer Success
```
jonathan_se: That reads fine. Suggest adding: contact link + dedicated Slack bridge. Also mark whether data/requests were retried.
kai_onboarding: Adding: "No customer data was exposed; requests may have failed briefly during token exchange."
nana_csm: I'll tailor the draft for Acme emphasizing renewal support and propose a 30-min executive briefing. Who's available for the briefing?
vinay_support: I can be on the call. ops_lead can cover the technical fix. jonathan_se — can you join for escalation?
ops_lead: Yes. After rollback I'll provide a short timeline and postmortem outline.
incident-bot: INC-5247 status -> mitigation in progress (rollback initiated).
maria_cs: Outreach cadence proposal: 1) immediate short note (sent now) 2) follow-up once mitigation confirmed (within 2h) 3) scheduled enablement + credit offer (within 48h) 4) full RCA + remediation timeline (72h). Thoughts? :thumbsup:
jonathan_se: +1. For Acme, recommend proactive credit top-up and offer a test run on Dedicated pool to prove stability.
kai_onboarding: I'll prepare per-account scripts for manual token reset and a checklist for success criteria.
nana_csm: I'll send the Acme-specific note and schedule their exec brief for tomorrow morning. Draft snippet I'll paste here in 10m.
vinay_support: Also capturing feedback: ask if they want a walkthrough of the private deployment settings that triggered this. Could reduce churn.
maria_cs: Good point. Add a short feedback checkbox: "Would you like a technical walkthrough (y/n)?" in the outreach.
ops_lead: Post-mitigation next steps (ops to deliver): rollback confirmation, token reset runbook, new integration test for KMS/token exchange, and a canary gating for future control-plane changes. Will include timeline in RCA.
incident-bot: INC-5247 updated -> rollback succeeded at 1999951560, validation started.
jonathan_se: Validation logs look OK so far. Can we pre-schedule the enablement invites so customers see a concrete next step?
maria_cs: Yes — I'll schedule invites and attach the manual reset instructions. We'll send the follow-up update once validation completes.
nana_csm: Sending Acme note now. copy: "We’ve initiated a control-plane rollback; expect manual reset within 60 minutes and a follow-up update shortly. We’re offering a credit and exec briefing — please pick a time: link".
vinay_support: I'll run manual resets for Harlow and BlueBay and confirm individually.
ops_lead: Thanks all. RCA draft will include timeline, root cause (KMS state mismatch after deploy), mitigation steps, and proposed process change: enforce canary + integration test.
maria_cs: Final ask: capture customer sentiment and churn risk in ticket fields after each outreach. I'll compile feedback and flags for renewal team. Keep replies short here — I'll consolidate into the outreach log. :pray:
vinay_support: Roger. Posting updates to the CS ticket once manual resets complete.
incident-bot: INC-5247 resolved -> monitoring. Final RCA ETA 72h.
